title: Verify SQL Server Management Studio connectivity after an unplanned restart on the FORTNA WCS primary host
summary: After an unplanned restart on the FORTNA WCS primary host, use RDP to open SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS) and confirm that you can successfully connect to the SQL Server on the host named fortna-wcs-primary.txrth.otnet.ups.com.
when_to_use: Use this as a basic validation step after an unplanned restart on the FORTNA WCS primary host to confirm SSMS connectivity before deeper service/DB connectivity troubleshooting.
roles_and_responsibilities: L2_support: Execute the RDP + SSMS connectivity check and determine whether connectivity succeeds or fails; stop and escalate if it fails.

visual_references.description: Frame showing: 'Rdp into fortna-wcs-primary.txrth.otnet.ups.com', 'Open Sql server management studio', and 'check that you can connect'.

steps.title: RDP to the FORTNA WCS primary host named in the check
steps.purpose: Get to the FORTNA WCS primary host so SSMS can be opened for the connectivity check.
steps.instruction: Use RDP to connect to the host named fortna-wcs-primary.txrth.otnet.ups.com.
steps.expected_result: You are connected to the host fortna-wcs-primary.txrth.otnet.ups.com and can launch applications on it.
steps.healthy_condition: RDP session is established and the host is reachable for interactive use.
steps.failure_condition: RDP cannot be established to fortna-wcs-primary.txrth.otnet.ups.com.

actions.label: Open RDP session to primary host

stop_or_escalate_if: If you cannot reach the host via RDP, stop and escalate for host/network access troubleshooting.

steps.healthy_condition: SSMS opens without errors and you can initiate a connection attempt.
steps.failure_condition: SSMS fails to open or cannot be used to attempt a SQL connection.
stop_or_escalate_if: If SSMS cannot be opened, stop and escalate for application/host troubleshooting.

steps.title: Attempt the SSMS connectivity check and confirm success
steps.purpose: Validate that SQL connectivity to the primary host is working after the unplanned restart.
steps.instruction: In SSMS, perform the connectivity check by verifying that you can connect (the connection attempt succeeds rather than failing).
steps.expected_result: The SSMS connection attempt succeeds (i.e., you are able to establish a connection rather than receiving a connection failure).
steps.healthy_condition: SSMS shows a successful connection state after the attempt.
steps.failure_condition: The SSMS connection attempt fails (cannot establish a connection).
stop_or_escalate_if: If the connection cannot be established, stop and escalate for further service/DB connectivity troubleshooting (do not proceed with dependent checks).

steps.purpose: Prevent further dependent checks when the basic SQL connectivity validation fails.
steps.instruction: If SSMS cannot connect, stop and escalate for further service/DB connectivity troubleshooting; do not proceed with dependent checks.
steps.expected_result: A failure outcome is recognized and escalation is initiated rather than continuing with downstream validation steps.

steps.failure_condition: Proceeding with dependent checks despite SSMS connectivity failure.
